gemini.title: Scheduled Monuments
gemini.abstract: Boundary polygons of nationally important archaeological sites scheduled under the Ancient Monuments and Archaeological Areas Act 1979 and recorded on the National Heritage List for England.
gemini.lineage: Published by Historic England as part of the National Heritage List for England (NHLE). Loaded into Systra PostGIS database without transformation.

columns.name: listentry
columns.description: Historic England List Entry number — unique identifier for a designated heritage asset.

columns.name: name
columns.description: Official or publisher-assigned name of the represented feature.

columns.name: scheddate
columns.description: Date on which the monument was first scheduled.

columns.name: amenddate
columns.description: Date the designation was last amended or updated.

columns.name: capturescale
columns.description: Map scale at which the boundary was originally captured.

columns.name: hyperlink
columns.description: URL linking to the official Historic England record for this asset.

columns.name: area_ha
columns.description: Area of the feature in hectares.

columns.name: ngr
columns.description: National Grid Reference — alphanumeric grid coordinate in British National Grid.

columns.name: easting
columns.description: Easting coordinate in British National Grid (EPSG:27700).

columns.name: northing
columns.description: Northing coordinate in British National Grid (EPSG:27700).

columns.name: objectid
columns.description: Source-system row identifier; useful internally but not guaranteed to remain stable between data releases.

columns.name: geom
columns.description: Spatial geometry of the represented feature.
